title: A Vision Worth Following — An Unfolding Story
synopsis: A compelling vision to improve accessibility and reduce delays sounds like a poster to employees who fear a hidden staffing cut.

opening.speaker: Wei Chen
opening.title: A Poster Is Not a Plan
opening.text: After your presentation, Wei asks, “What changes on Monday, or is this just another slogan?” Several teammates nod.
opening.prompt: What do you say to connect purpose to the team's work?

choices.text: Explain the customer purpose, invite workflow examples, and name two testable priorities.

ending-damaged.text: An impressive slogan masks degraded access and unresolved staff concerns. Trust collapses when the results surface.
